title: Beanstalk Bounce Runner
heading: Beanstalk Bounce
help: Pick a step, click Green flag, and steer with the left and right arrow keys.

1.name: Gravity and bounce
1.note: vy shrinks every frame; landing on a leaf sets it back to 11.

2.name: Climb forever
2.note: A camera follows the frog up: everything is drawn at height − camera.

3.name: Level numbers
3.note: The gaps between leaves grow with the height (minGap, maxGap).

4.name: Leaf kinds
4.note: Moving, dry and mushroom leaves; the frog tells them apart with touching color.

5.name: Bees
5.note: Bees fly to and fro; a sting knocks the frog down. This is the whole game.
